content: Official FPL 'My Team' page and third-party creators source shirt/kit images from the Premier League's own kits web resources (premierleague.com); away kits are made publicly downloadable by the PL. No public documented CDN path was found via search, but the pattern (official PL-hosted kit PNGs, not custom-drawn kits) is corroborated; club crests/logos remain trademarked and should not be redrawn or reused without the shirt-image route.
